_about: Ties of a person to a place that the key verse TIPNR gives does not bear out, checked against the KJV and the Synodal text for every person tied to a place as central or supporting (2026-10-02). `ties`: the person was not there by the text, dropped. `verses`: they were, and this verse shows it (one the place's own verses include).
